Nina (Aurora): Hi team — we want to onboard a private claims summarizer for Aurora Ops. Key constraints: PHI redaction, customer-managed KMS/HSM, EU residency for some tenants. Pilot target: ~6 weeks. Who can own end-to-end?
OnboardBot: Ticket CS-4810 created. Checklist: sample data, KMS spec, eval plan, SLA signoff.
Theo: @Nina I can own the infra rollout. Can you upload a small sample set (50-100 claims) with labels for redaction and expected outputs? Any latency SLOs?
Nina (Aurora): Uploading now to secure bucket. SLO: p95 <= 300ms, steady 40 req/s, audit logs retained 12 months. EU residency: ~25% of traffic must be eu-west pinned.
Rita: ML note — we'll need ~200 annotated examples for robust redaction eval, plus bias checks. Plan: start with private-7b-q + KV cache; compare to 13B if accuracy insufficient. Quantization tradeoffs will be posted.
Sam: HSM provisioning can take 10 business days post-contract. Leo (AE) please confirm contract addendum for HSM.
Leon (AE): I'll chase procurement.
Theo: Canary plan draft:
```
canary: 5% -> private-7b-q (eu-west pinned)
scale: 5% -> 25% -> 100%
fallback: private-3b-distilled
```
I'll enable prefix caching and region pin.
Rita: I'll prepare eval template (redaction matrix, hallucination probes, OOD). Expect first pass ~7 working days after samples are in. Will set thresholds for redaction FNR/FPR.
Nina (Aurora): Renewal risk flagged — if latency or redaction fails, renewal at risk. Prioritize HSM timeline.
OnboardBot: Reminder — attach KMS ARNs and sample S3 path to move to security review.
Theo: I'll schedule an enablement call for Tue 10am PT. Owners: Theo infra rollout, Rita ML evals, Nina CS lead.
Nina (Aurora): Thanks all, will update ticket CS-4810 with links.
